item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Janet Jackson - Discipline era multitracks/stems/demos (2008)
item.description:
Hi everyone !

I want this post to be about Janet Jackson's album DISCIPLINE (2008).

I am looking for multitracks, stems, demos, remixes of any songs from this album 'Discipline', especially unreleased material !

If anyone has anything to share in high quality MP3 or lossless, please do !

I am also looking for the full demo of "LUV", entitled "Lovecident" sung by the jamaican singer Tasleema.
